column1: # ⚠ THE LABIOVELAR SUB-SERIES: FIVE MEMBERS EACH, AND THE ORDER IS ⟨ʷə ʷi ʷa ʷe ʷɨ⟩.
# `makeGeezG2P` reads a fidel with no row here as the EMPTY STRING, so a missing member deletes its whole
# ⟨ቊ⟩ ×6 on that, and enumerating the Unicode block showed it was systematic — KXW ⟨ዀ ዂ ዃ ዄ ዅ⟩ and QHW
# ⟨ቘ ቚ ቛ ቜ ቝ⟩ were complete and correct, while QW/KW/GW held THREE of five each AND mapped their 1st-order
# member (ETHIOPIC SYLLABLE QWA/KWA/GWA) to the 5th order's vowel — ቈ kʼʷe, ኰ kʷe, ጐ ɡʷe.
# The 1st order is /ə/ everywhere else in THIS FILE (ሀ hə, ዀ xʷə, ቘ kʼʷə) and the 5th is /e/ (ሄ he), so the
# file contradicted itself. The epitran tir-Ethi referee agrees: ቈለ qʷələ, ኰርኰረ kʷərɨkʷərə, ተርጐመ tərɨɡʷəmə.
# ⚠ ጔ and ቌ have ZERO corpus instances and are written anyway — a series with one member left out is the
# defect this note exists to explain, and leaving the same hole in a different order repeats it.
